name: PJSC IVA
summary: PJSC IVA, operating as IVA Technologies, stands as a leading Russian technology enterprise dedicated to developing comprehensive software ecosystems for corporate communications. Its foundational suite of products encompasses platforms for secure video conferencing, instant messaging services, IP telephony, and collaborative work environments. These robust and scalable solutions are primarily tailored for large enterprises and governmental organizations. The company is strategically positioned as a pivotal contributor to the import substitution of communication technologies within its home market.
